purpose: Targeted check for ADR-062 (01.10.2026): a legal source's valid_from starts a consolidated version of the act and is not the day a provision or an amount began. On 30.09 the Märjamaa answer gave the birth grant as in force "alates 4. septembrist 2026" and could not say whether it covers a child born in August; a Kuusalu answer dated the housing cost limit from 15 September. Written before any run; one run on corpus v47 with model context json-3 and dialogue prompt 22.

expectation_help.region: the municipal scope of the turn
expectation_help.cited: the act with the rates is among the cited sources
expectation_help.must / must_not: regular expressions on the visible answer text. Märjamaa must_not: the version's start day as a date in the answer; a doubt about the August birth; the act's year of entry into force beside the amount in one sentence (the amount is of 2026; a dot after a digit, as in '1. juulist 2018', does not end the sentence). Kuusalu must: the amount and the day the regulation is applied from (§ 5 lg 1) in any of its written forms; must_not: the version's start day

turns.text: Meil sündis augustis laps ja elame Märjamaa vallas, kus olen ise elanud juba mitu aastat. Kui suure sünnitoetuse vald maksab ja kas see makstakse kõik korraga välja?

scenarios.title: Kuusalu eluasemekulude piirmäär ja selle algus
scenarios.source: live check 30.09, with one clause added so that the answer must give a date

turns.text: Elan Kuusalu vallas üksi 1-toalises üürikorteris, mille üldpind on 40 m² ja üür 520 eurot kuus. Olen 38-aastane ja töövõimeline – kui suure osa üürist võtab vald toimetulekutoetuse arvutamisel arvesse ja mis ajast see piirmäär kehtib?
